title: Track your Google rankings and AI visibility in one place for life for $69
excerpt: Find out if ChatGPT and Google are mentioning your website.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get your website noticed on Google and AI search with this lifetime subscription to SEOAgent, now only $69 (reg. $999).

Credit: SEOAgent

$69
$999 Save $930

These days, getting your website noticed online takes more than sprinkling a few popular keywords into your content. You’ve also got to be on top of what people are searching for, which terms you can rank for, and whether your brand is showing up in AI answers. SEOAgent helps you keep track of all this info in one convenient spot.

Right now, you can lock in a lifetime subscription to SEOAgent Tier 1 for just $69.

It’s 2026 — you can’t just try to optimize your website to pop up on Google and call it a day. You’ve got to take a different approach, and SEOAgent can help. This SEO platform actually reads your website and finds Google searches it can realistically rank for, while also tracking how you’re showing up in search and AI answers.

Instead of wasting time on high-volume keywords you don’t have a chance of winning with, get queries that could actually help your site thrive.

The best tech deal this week

The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile

With SEOAgent, you connect Google Search Console, GA4, PostHog, and Bing to see traffic right next to your rankings. You can run an audit of your site and even see whether the big AI models like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews are naming or citing your brand.

Unlike other tools, SEOAgent focuses on winnability. Your 5 keyword research runs will help you find searches your site can realistically rank for, without just focusing on volume. You can also follow your Google positions for the searches that matter most for your site via 50 tracked keywords. It can even find technical SEO issues that might be holding your site back in the rankings.

This lifetime subscription to Tier 1 works for one website and includes 1,000 credits per month, 50 tracked keywords, 5 keyword research runs, and 4 AI visibility questions.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Get your own lifetime subscription to SEOAgent Tier 1 for just $69 today.
